provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.evidence.mechanical_execution against rust:mdbook-dada/src/mechanical.rs:run, rust:mdbook-dada/src/mechanical.rs:snapshot, rust:mdbook-dada/src/mechanical.rs:Execution::validate, rust:mdbook-dada/src/mechanical.rs:status, rust:mdbook-dada/src/mechanical.rs:records, rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:check, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:execution_preserves_success_failure_and_non_utf8_output, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:execution_retains_source_mutations_additions_and_deletions, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:failed_after_snapshot_and_launch_failures_are_retained, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:status_and_record_validation_never_execute_profile_commands, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:source_or_profile_changes_stale_receipts_without_corrupting_history, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:later_failures_and_tied_failures_cannot_be_hidden_by_success, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:receipt_validation_rejects_tampering_and_profile_substitution, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:receipt_validation_requires_selected_sources_and_runner_snapshots, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:snapshots_record_empty_directories_and_ignore_generated_outputs, test:mdbook-dada/tests/mechanical.rs:snapshots_and_records_reject_symbolic_links, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:workspace_validation_rejects_malformed_execution_receipts. run snapshots before/after, captures both version probes and command outputs, and retains failed launch/recapture results. succeeded requires identical version results and snapshots plus successful command. validate checks required directory membership and profile consistency; status uses the latest finish time and gives stale/failure precedence on ties. The tests cover source mutations, binary output, missing required snapshots, symlinks, tampering and nonexecution during validation; none authenticates the runner or a hermetic environment. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
